title: Reading an offer: contract, benefits, equity and the small print

videos.script: The call comes: we would like to make you an offer. After weeks of applications, the temptation is to say yes on the phone. {{call}} Say you are delighted, and ask for it in writing. An offer is several things at once, and the monthly number is only one of them. {{several}} The contract, the probation, the benefits, the hours and a few clauses in the small print decide what the job is really like. {{decide}} This lesson breaks an offer into its parts, reads the ones that surprise people, and compares two offers without being fooled by the bigger number.
